title: Περὶ συνδέσμων / On Conjunctions (alternative: Περὶ συντάξεως Book I) / «О союзах»
author: Apollonius Dyscolus
size: Conjunctions about 45 Teubner pp. (estimate 10k words). Syntax is 4 books, about 500 pp.
edition: R. Schneider, GG II.1 (1878; PD). G. Uhlig, GG II.2 (1910; PD).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Аполлоний Дискол) lists only studies (Dobiash 1882; Polikarpov 2007), no translation.
en_evidence: Syntax: Householder 1981 (standard bibliography). De pronomine pars generalis with English translation (Schmidhauser PhD 2007, per en.wikipedia). No English found for Conjunctions.
other_translations: From standard bibliography, not re-verified: French, Syntax (Lallot 1997) and Conjunctions (Dalimier 2001); Spanish, Syntax (Gredos 1987).
value: Founding work of Western syntax, behind Priscian and Byzantine grammar. Russian linguists and historians of linguistics lack direct access.
ai_feasibility: medium: dense technical argument, corrupt text, and terminology that must stay consistent. A strong test for multi-model review.
